purpose: Find out whether the 401 depends on the payment: refund endpoint called on a REJECTED payment, which cannot move money by construction
safety: the tool refuses to run unless the payment is rejected or cancelled and belongs to the QA seller; fresh idempotency key; no body
reading: Same 401 cause 7 on a rejected payment: the refusal happens in the authorization layer, before the payment is looked at. A read of the refund list with the same token answers 200.
